phases.title:
The answer was never
the whole job.
phases.text: First came the work of finding the context.
phases.description: A run record, recipe, reference, measurements and review note arrive separately, at different depths.

phases.title:
The context had
to be built.
phases.description: The run is matched to its trace. Recipe steps meet their reference. A changed step links to the corresponding observation, and the note joins the event.

phases.title:
New work.
Same reconstruction.
phases.description: The completed first task shrinks into an archive and disappears. A different run arrives, with new values but the same gaps to reconstruct.

phases.title:
Good reasoning should
outlive the task.
phases.description: The evidence changes, but its alignment guide stays. The next comparison settles directly into that retained structure.

phases.title:
So I kept the part
worth repeating.
phases.description: The comparison guide, event relationship and review check separate from temporary records and become reusable working spaces.

phases.title:
I built the part
I wanted to keep.
phases.description: The retained structure gains input boundaries, a comparison state and a repeatable check. Reasoning becomes something that can be used again.

phases.title: Then I put it to work.
phases.description: The working spaces open in depth. Those same frames become the positions occupied by the real ARTIFACTS applications.
